information.description:
The former colonel who took Dogtown for the NUSA, was abandoned at war's end, and built his own homeland there on smuggling and arms deals. Warlord, deserter or liberator, depending on who you ask.

Barghest: Kurt Hansen's militia, the deserter army that holds Dogtown.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

Kurt Hansen: Kurt's Iconic Pistol; EQ; See Bald Eagle's full listing; x8 Armor-Piercing

Armor-Piercing only, at the price of Basic. Aimed Shots deal +1d6 (5d6). A Leg Aimed Shot on a leg that's already broken dismembers it instead. With one hand free, reload by giving up your Move Action.

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • POWER

Item Compendium (2070) • Iconics

Kurt Hansen: Kurt's Iconic MG; EQ; Has Auto-Compensator; See Wild Dog's full listing; x150 High-Velocity

Armor-Piercing only, at the price of Basic (this gun only). Autofire and Suppressive Fire only. Autofire uses 15 rounds; with fewer left it empties as Machine Gun 3. +2 on Suppressive Fire. If it Autofired last Round, its rating climbs by 1 (up to Machine Gun 7), using 5 more rounds per step. At ratings 6 and 7, a single 6 on the damage is a Critical Injury. Reloading takes three Reload Actions. Unmounted, without BODY 10+ or paired cyberarms, −2 MOVE while held.

Class: Excellent Quality Machine Gun • POWER
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire
Built-in: Auto-Compensator, Bipod, Power Rebuild, TUp (ROF 1, Very Heavy Melee) Stun Bayonet
Fabrication: Hansen’s not goin’ to let this one off its leash. (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged)
